 AI Generated Summary Gigi Hadid and Bradley Cooper have reignited speculation about a possible secret wedding after both were spotted wearing gold rings on their left ring fingers during separate outings in New York City.
 The 31-year-old supermodel and the 51-year-old actor were photographed leaving Cooper’s residence at different times on Wednesday. Their matching-looking jewellery quickly caught attention, adding to ongoing rumours that the couple may have secretly tied the knot.
 Hadid opted for a relaxed winter look, wearing a long brown coat, leather boots, a striped beanie and sunglasses. She completed her outfit with gold earrings and the ring that has become a talking point among fans.
 Meanwhile, Cooper wore a navy button-down shirt, blue jeans and white sneakers. He also sported a light blue beanie, sunglasses and headphones, while a gold band on his left ring finger fuelled further speculation.
 The couple first sparked marriage rumours in August when they were seen wearing matching gold bands during a trip to Paris. Reports at the time suggested the jewellery came from French luxury jeweller Boucheron.
 Hadid’s ring was reportedly identified as a yellow-gold wedding band featuring diamonds, while Cooper was said to be wearing a pink-gold band from the same brand.
 Iran claims to shoot down 58th US drone over Strait of Hormuz Musadik Malik calls for regional action against terrorism King Charles and Camilla steal the spotlight at royal gala Houthis strike Riyadh after Saudi-led coalition attacks Yemen Last month, the supermodel further intensified speculation when she was spotted wearing the ring backstage at the 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show.
 Despite the growing rumours, neither Hadid nor Cooper has publicly confirmed that they are married.
 The couple have been romantically linked for around three years after meeting at a birthday party for a mutual friend’s child. Hadid recently spoke about their relationship in a September cover interview with Vogue, praising their honesty and open communication.
 Both stars also have children from previous relationships. Hadid shares her six-year-old daughter, Khai, with former partner Zayn Malik, while Cooper has a daughter, Lea De Seine, with model Irina Shayk.
